bull_bear.body: No dividend or buyback guidance; capital allocation focused on executing order book; seed money (INR481cr) fully allocated to Amrapali (INR465cr) and DTC (INR16.5cr); no NBFC planned as HUDCO provides financing
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation

bull_bear.body: Delays in state government approvals (J&K, Kerala); HUDCO loan disbursement timing for redevelopment projects; Supreme Court outcome on Super-Tech (Dec 8, 2025); real estate sales slower than expected due to shift to leasing model
bull_bear.title: Risks & watch-items

bull_bear.body: Confident and bullish; emphasized execution momentum, strong order pipeline, and transformation from PMC to high-margin redevelopment; highlighted pride in resolving stalled projects (Amrapali) and unlocking PSU land value; clear focus on FY28 double-digit EBITDA
bull_bear.title: Management quality / tone

bull_bear.body: NBCC is effectively a real estate developer disguised as an EPC firm — its order book is 53% redevelopment, but revenue recognition is delayed until handover; the INR481cr seed money is not debt but client-funded escrow; leasing strategy (Bhubaneswar, Ghitorni, WTC) converts one-time sales into recurring income
bull_bear.title: Non-obvious takeaways

bull_bear.body:
- Declared an interim dividend of Rs 0.15 per share in the Q1 FY 26-27 round up.
- The deck carries a "Value Creation" slide referencing Net Worth (Rs Cr), Returns (%) with ROE = PAT/Avg. Net Worth and ROCE = EBIT/(Net worth - Notional assets), Employee Productivity and Shareholders' Wealth (DPS and EPS, adjusted, with the FY 2025-26 final proposed dividend included) - but the underlying chart values did not survive text extraction, so no series is asserted here.
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body: Amrapali: H1 FY26 revenue INR1,054cr; Phase 2 (INR17,000cr sales, INR12,000cr cost) to drive future revenue; GPRA/Netaji Nagar: INR1,450cr completed, INR7,000cr pending award (INR4,000-5,000cr in Q3); Sarojini Nagar: INR8,000cr ongoing, INR5,000cr pipeline; Real Estate: FY26 revenue guidance INR65cr (vs INR26cr H1); Ghitorni (21 acres, INR7,000-8,000cr revenue), 37D Gurgaon (INR2,200cr revenue) to launch in FY27-28
business.title: Segment / subsidiary detail

business.title: Challenges → beneficiaries & losers

business.body:
- Navratna CPSE under the Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA), described as "One of the Largest Construction CPSE in India" with "65+ years of experience (Incorporated in 1960)" and "PAN India & Global Presence".
- Three business segments: Project Management Consultancy (PMC), Engineering Procurement & Consultancy (EPC) and Real Estate; the deck names the "PMC Model" and "Redevelopment Model" as the Business Model - USP.
- Marquee delivery credentials cited: Hon'ble PM inaugurated the World Trade Centre at Nauroji Nagar and the WHO-SEARO Headquarters, and NBCC developed "Bharat Mandpam" - the G20 hosted venue.
- Group structure of subsidiaries: HSCC - 100%, HSCL - 51%, NSL - 100%, NBCC Overseas Real Estate LLC - 100%, DWC LLC - 100%.
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [History] Milestones: incorporated 1960, diversified into real estate 1977, IPO April 2012, Navratna status and NSL incorporation 2014, HSCC acquisition 2017, overseas market entry 2018, HSCL acquisition 2022.
- [Stalled-project mandate] The deck flags 2023 as the start of delivery of the stalled real estate project Amrapali.
- [Leadership] Board led by CMD Shri K. P. Mahadevaswamy (32+ years in mega-value civil engineering projects), with Dr. Suman Kumar as Director (Commercial) and Shri Anjeev Kumar Jain as Director (Finance); two MoHUA Govt. Nominee Directors (Shri Ravi Kumar Arora, IAS, and Shri Sanjeet).
- [Label ambiguity] In the "New Business Secured & Work Awarded as on 30.06.2026" table the deck prints the row label "Total Business Secured in Q1 FY 2026-27" twice - once under New Business Secured (NBCC Rs 1,211 Cr; consolidated Rs 1,580 Cr) and again under Works Awarded to Contractors (NBCC Rs 1,352 Cr; consolidated Rs 1,689 Cr). The round-up slide corroborates NBCC Rs 1,352 Cr as "Works Awarded" and Rs 1,211 Cr as "New Business secured".
business.title: Notable from the deck

latest_quarter.body: EBITDA margin temporarily down due to lower Amrapali marketing fees (1% fee, only delayed this quarter); long-term margin expansion expected from redevelopment projects (30-40% PAT margin on Ghitorni/37D); fixed overheads will drive operating leverage as revenue scales
latest_quarter.title: Margins & cost dynamics

outlook.body: Revenue growth: 20%+ YoY (FY26), 18,000cr+ (FY27); Margin: EBITDA 6-6.5% (FY26), double-digit by FY28; Order inflow: 10,000cr+ in H2FY26 (total FY26: 20,000cr+); Capex/commissioning: No NBCC capex; client-funded redevelopment projects commissioning from Q4FY26 onwards
outlook.title: Guidance

outlook.body: INR1,28,000cr consolidated (INR1,12,000cr standalone); 67,000cr redevelopment (53%); 61,000cr PMC (47%); 34,000cr running; 40,000cr pending start (MAHAPREIT + J&K); 10,000cr+ to be awarded in H2FY26
outlook.title: Order book & pipeline

outlook.body: PSU land redevelopment pipeline: HPCL (Bangalore, INR1,500cr), HMT, MTNL/BSNL (Delhi), Balmer Lawrie, Richardson & Cruddas; International: UAE (Pantheon Elysee MOU), African Zoo project; Ghitorni and 37D could add INR10,000cr+ revenue by FY28
outlook.title: Growth verticals / optionality

deepdive.thesis: NBCC's consolidated revenue and PAT grew 20% and 25% YoY due to strong order inflow and Amrapali project contributions, with EBITDA margin temporarily pressured by lower marketing fees; the key shift is the transition from PMC-only to high-margin redevelopment projects like MAHAPREIT and Ghitorni, which will unlock 30-40% margins and double-digit EBITDA by FY28.
